message.content:
**Yes – you can file a noise complaint in Atlanta.**  
Noise complaints are handled by the City of Atlanta’s Police Department and Code‑Enforcement teams, not by a “local council” in the way you might find in some other countries. Here’s how you can do it:

| Method | What to do | Contact |
|--------|------------|---------|
| **Phone** | Call the Atlanta Police Department’s 311 service (or the non‑emergency line) and report the noise. | 404‑656‑3111 (Atlanta 311) |
| **Online** | Use the City of Atlanta’s 311 online portal to submit a noise complaint. | https://www.atlantaga.gov/311 |
| **In‑person** | Visit the nearest police precinct or the City of Atlanta’s Code Enforcement office. | 404‑656‑3111 for directions |
| **Mail** | Send a written complaint to the City of Atlanta Police Department. | 404‑656‑3111 (for mailing address) |

### Quick Steps for an Online Complaint

1. Go to the 311 portal: <https://www.atlantaga.gov/311>.
2. Select **“Noise”** or **“Code Enforcement”** from the list of services.
3. Fill out the form with details (time, location, description of the noise, any witnesses).
4. Submit the form. You’ll receive a confirmation number and a link to track the status.

### Tips

- **Time of day matters**: Noise ordinances are stricter during nighttime hours (typically 10 p.m.–7 a.m.). Be sure to note the exact time of the disturbance.
- **Document evidence**: If possible, record the noise or take photos of the source (e.g., a loud party, construction equipment).
- **Follow up**: If you don’t hear back within a few days, call 404‑656‑3111 and reference your confirmation number.

### Where to Find the Ordinance

The City of Atlanta’s noise ordinance is part of the **Atlanta Municipal Code, Title 12 – Public Health and Safety, Chapter 12-1 – Noise**. You can read the full text here: <https://www.atlantaga.gov/municipal-code> (search for “noise”).

---

**Bottom line:** Yes, you can report noise complaints in Atlanta. Use the 311 phone line or online portal, or visit a police precinct. The city’s police and code‑enforcement teams will investigate and enforce the noise ordinance.
